metadata.name: tachoparser
metadata.summary: Decode, inspect, and verify digital and smart tachograph data files

content.value: tachoparser is an open-source parsing and verification utility written in Go for processing digital tachograph driver card and vehicle unit (VU) data. It interprets raw tachograph binary files (.DDD, .TGD, .V1B) according to official technical specifications and converts complex record structures into standardized JSON.

Designed for flexibility across desktop and server workflows, the suite includes standalone command-line tools, a lightweight graphical dialog interface, and gRPC service integrations for automated data analysis pipelines.

items.value: Parses both first-generation digital tachograph (DT) and second-generation smart tachograph (ST) files
Verifies data authenticity using member state and root certificate public keys
Outputs fully structured JSON from STDIN to STDOUT for easy scripting and pipeline integration
Provides simplified extraction utilities for quick retrieval of driver names and identification numbers
Includes a built-in Zenity-based UI for interactive file selection and conversion
Features high-performance gRPC server and client components for networked file parsing
